A '''tribe''' of [[Shaman/Legends|shamanistic]] [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolans]] lived on the [[Ash Plains]] of [[Lenico IV]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. Around [[3678 BBY]], the Ortolan's [[Ortolan village|village]] was visited by the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Exal Kressh]], who learned their [[The Force/Legends|Force]] techniques and then proceeded to [[Massacre on Lenico IV|massacre]] the members of the tribe.

The members of this tribe appeared much more slender than Ortolans from [[Orto/Legends|Orto]], which considered them as a separate [[Subspecies/Legends|race]] of Ortolans.
